title: Implemented the Growth Data API and the growth change log
reason: Expose decision-quality, aggregated growth data (traffic, funnel, commercial, first-touch and last-touch attribution, content-level UTM breakdowns) to an external growth agent, and give it a record of growth-relevant product changes to read alongside the numbers
author: claude-code
notes: Read-only. Own bearer token GROWTH_AGENT_TOKEN (503 until set on the server). No public page, copy, price or tracking change; visitor-facing behaviour is unchanged, so no metric is expected to move.
